title: QP decode with max_bytes: entire body decoded before truncation
description: decode.rs: for TransferEncoding::QuotedPrintable, the entire body_bytes is decoded before max_bytes truncation is applied. For a 10 MB QP-encoded body with max_bytes=256 (preview), this decodes 10 MB to produce 256 bytes. Contrast with the Base64 path which pre-truncates to max_b64_chars before decoding. Impact: O(N) allocation and CPU where N is the full encoded body length, even for small previews. Acceptable if QP bodies are always small; a real cost for large QP attachments.
